decisions.reason: As a relatively low-cost ecosystem and deal-flow option linked to the established business, it still offers learning value under uncertainty, so we would keep it for now.
This binder appears farther from the firm's machinery-and-recycling core and would need heavier follow-on commitment in a different market, so its option value looks weaker and we would drop it.
The infectious-waste decontamination plant is close to the firm's modular waste-treatment capabilities and supported by partnership-based positioning, so the option remains attractive to keep open.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant is a direct extension of the firm's core technology and customer base, so keeping it on the market is a strong low-regret option while demand develops.
